select_choices_or_calculations: 1, Demonstrates knowledge of care coordination. | 2, Coordinates care of patients by effectively engaging interprofessional teams in routine clinical situations. 3, Coordinates care of patients by effectively engaging interprofessional teams in complex clinical situations. | 4, Models effective coordination of patient-centered care among different disciplines and specialties. | 5, Analyzes the process of care coordination and leads in the design and implementation of improvements.

field_label: SBP2 row 2
select_choices_or_calculations: 1, Identifies key elements for safe and effective transitions of care and hand-offs. | 2, Performs safe and effective transitions of care/hand-offs in routine clinical situations. | 3, Performs safe and effective transitions of care/hand-offs in complex clinical situations. | 4, Models and advocates for safe and effective transitions of care/hand-offs within and across health care delivery systems. | 5, Improves quality of transitions of care within and across health care delivery systems to optimize patient outcomes.

field_label: SBP2 row 3
select_choices_or_calculations: 1, Demonstrates knowledge of population and community health needs and disparities. | 2, Identifies specific population and community health needs and inequities for the local population. | 3, Uses local resources effectively to meet the needs of a patient population and community. | 4, Participates in changing and adapting practice to provide for the needs of specific populations. | 5, Leads innovations and advocates for populations and communities with health care inequities

field_label: SBP3 row 1
select_choices_or_calculations: 1, Identifies key components of the health care system. | 2, Describes how components of a complex health care system are interrelated, and how this impacts patient care. | 3, Discusses how individual practice affects the regional and national health care system. | 4, Manage various components of the complex health care system to provide efficient and effective patient care. | 5, Advocates for patient care needs with consideration of the limitations of each patient's payment model.

field_label: SBP3 row 2
select_choices_or_calculations: 1, Describes basic health payment systems. | 2, Delivers care with consideration of each patient's payment model. | 3, Engages with patients in shared decision making, informed by each patient's payment models. | 4, Advocates for patient care needs with consideration of the limitations of each patient's payment model. | 5, Actively engaged in influencing health policy through advocacy activities at the local, regional, or national level.

field_label: PBL1 row 1
select_choices_or_calculations: 1, Demonstrates how to access, categorize, and analyze clinical evidence, with guidance. | 2, Articulates clinical questions and elicits patient preferences and values to guide evidence-based care. | 3, Critically appraises and applies the best available evidence, integrated with patient preference, to the care of complex patients. | 4, Applies evidence, even in the face of uncertainty and conflicting evidence, to guide care, tailored to the individual patient. | 5, Coaches others to critically appraise and apply evidence to patient care.

field_label: PBL2 row 1
select_choices_or_calculations: 1, Accepts responsibility for personal and professional development by establishing goals. | 2, Demonstrates openness to performance data (feedback and other input) to inform goals. | 3, Seeks performance data episodically, with adaptability, and humility. | 4, Seeks performance data consistently with adaptability, and humility. | 5, Models consistently seeking performance data with adaptability and humility.

field_label: PBL2 row 2
select_choices_or_calculations: 1, Identifies the factors that contribute to gap(s) between ideal and actual performance, with guidance. | 2, Analyzes and reflects on the factors which contribute to gap(s) between ideal and actual performance, with guidance. | 3, Institutes behavioral change(s) to narrow the gap(s) between ideal and actual performance. | 4, Challenges one's own assumptions and considers alternatives in narrowing the gap(s) between ideal and actual performance. | 5, Coaches others on reflective practices

field_label: PBL2 row 3
select_choices_or_calculations: 1, N/A | 2, Actively seeks opportunities to improve. | 3, Designs and implements an individualized learning plan, with prompting. | 4, Independently creates and implements an individualized learning plan. | 5, Use performance data to measure the effectiveness of the individualized learning plan and when necessary, improves it.

field_label: Prof1 row 1
select_choices_or_calculations: 1, Demonstrates professional behavior in routine situations. | 2, Identifies potential triggers for professionalism lapses and accepts responsibility for one's own professionalism lapses. | 3, Demonstrates a pattern of professional behavior in complex or stressful situations. | 4, Recognizes situations that may trigger professionalism lapses and intervenes to prevent lapses in oneself and others. | 5, Coaches others when their behavior fails to meet professional expectations.

field_label: Prof2 row 2
select_choices_or_calculations: 1, Demonstrates knowledge of basic ethical principles. | 2, Applies basic principles to address straightforward ethical situations. | 3, Analyzes complex situations using ethical principles and identifies the need to seek help in addressing complex ethical situations. | 4, Analyzes complex situations and engages with appropriate resources for managing and addressing ethical dilemmas as needed. | 5, Identifies and seeks to address system-level factors that induce or exacerbate ethical problems or impede their resolution.

field_label: Prof3 row 1
select_choices_or_calculations: 1, Performs administrative tasks and patient care responsibilities, with prompting. | 2, Performs administrative tasks and patient care responsibilities in a timely manner in routine situations. | 3, Performs administrative tasks and patient care responsibilities in a timely manner in complex or stressful situations. | 4, Proactively implements strategies to ensure that the needs of patients, teams, and systems are met. | 5, Creates strategies to enhance others' ability to efficiently complete administrative tasks and patient care responsibilities.

field_label: Prof4 row 1
select_choices_or_calculations: 1, Recognizes the importance of getting help when needed to address personal and professional well-being. | 2, Lists resources to support personal and professional well-being. | 3, With prompting, reflects on how personal and professional well-being may impact one's clinical practice. | 4, Reflects on actions in real time to proactively respond to the inherent emotional challenges of physician work. | 5, Participates in institutional changes to promote personal and professional well-being.

field_label: Prof4 row 2
select_choices_or_calculations: 1, N/A | 2, Recognizes that institutional factors affect well-being. | 3, Describes institutional factors that affect well-being. | 4, Suggests potential solutions to institutional factors that affect well-being. | 5, N/A

field_label: ICS1 row 1

field_label: ICS1 row 2
